官方资料核验于 2026-09-09。路线、停留时长与取舍为 BAYLINK 编: Official sources checked September 9, 2026. Routes, suggested durations and priorities are BAYLINK editorial recommendations. Recheck opening, prices, schedules and temporary restrictions before leaving. Photos are reference images with their capture years noted.
唐人街到 North Beach：从龙门走到广场，读懂两个生活街区: Chinatown to North Beach: from Dragon Gate to the square, through two living neighborhoods
少一点追网红店，多一点看店招、街巷与居民生活: Notice signs, side streets and everyday life between food stops
串联 Dragon Gate、Grant Avenue、Waverly Plac: Link Dragon Gate, Grant Avenue, Waverly Place, Columbus Avenue and Washington Square. Plan for hills, meals and transit while respecting people who live and work here.
带外地朋友认识旧金山的人: Locals introducing friends to San Francisco
核对龙门位置、Grant、Waverly 与 Stockton 街区特色。: Check Dragon Gate’s location and the roles of Grant, Waverly and Stockton streets.
了解意裔社区、Columbus、City Lights 与 Washington: Learn about the Italian-American neighborhood and the relationship between Columbus, City Lights and Washington Square.
查询 T Third 车站与当天到站信息。: Check the T Third station and current arrival information.
核对华埠站位于 Stockton 与 Washington 街的交通位置。: Confirm the Chinatown station’s location at Stockton and Washington streets.
这条线适合想认识旧金山，而不只是拍到一张牌坊照片的人。编辑建议预留 2—3 小时: This route is for getting to know San Francisco beyond a photo of a gateway. Allow an editorial estimate of 2–3 hours for a relaxed walk, plus time for a seated meal. Chinatown and North Beach are neighbors with different signs, languages, food and migration histories. North Beach is not a beach outing today; a coffee by the square makes a natural finish.
把街道当街道，把小店当正在营业的地方: Remember these are working streets and businesses
唐人街不是统一开关门的景区，公共街道散步不收门票；店铺、寺庙、博物馆和餐厅各自决: Chinatown is not a gated attraction with one opening schedule. Public streets are free to walk, while shops, temples, museums and restaurants set their own hours and charges. Grant Avenue introduces gateways and architecture; Waverly Place rewards attention to balconies and facades. Stockton Street is also a place for everyday grocery shopping. Leave room for customers, do not handle merchandise casually, and ask before photographing people or interiors.
龙门进，Washington Square 收尾: Enter at Dragon Gate, finish at Washington Square
按开放的人行道连接四站，街区有坡度。选择公交到华埠站时可从中段开始；不必为了路线: Connect the four stops on open sidewalks and expect hills. If arriving by transit at Chinatown station, start midway instead of doubling back to Dragon Gate just to follow this order.
在 Grant 与 Bush 街交口看牌坊，从人行道拍照，不站进车道。: See the gateway at Grant and Bush from the sidewalk; do not step into traffic for a photo.
向北慢走，选择一小段街巷观察；私人楼梯和住宅入口不当捷径。: Walk north and explore a short side-street segment. Private stairs and residential entrances are not shortcuts.
到 Broadway 一带转向 Columbus；书店是否入内按营业时间决定。: Join Columbus near Broadway, entering the bookstore only if it is open.
沿 Columbus 到广场附近休息，另查返程公交，不把登 Coit Tower: Continue along Columbus to rest near the square. Check return transit without making a Coit Tower climb compulsory.
用餐留一站就够，别用排队填满整条线: Choose one meal stop rather than a route full of lines
想比较两个街区的味道，可以先在唐人街买少量点心，再到 North Beach 坐: To sample both neighborhoods, you could buy a small snack in Chinatown and sit down for coffee or a meal in North Beach. That is an option, not a requirement to spend. Ask about prices, minimum orders and allergens. If a line is too long, choose another place. Avoid treating claims that all locals eat somewhere as fact, or assuming a business’s welcome from the language on its signs.
穿适合坡道的鞋，同行者需要少走路时从华埠站或中途公交站接入。: Wear shoes suited to hills; use Chinatown station or an intermediate bus stop if someone needs a shorter walk.
广场座位、商店门口和窄巷都留出通道，不围拍下棋或休息的居民。: Leave passages clear around square seating, shop doors and narrow alleys; do not crowd residents for photos.
随身保管手机和钱包，过街先看信号；不用边走边盯着地图。: Keep your phone and wallet secure, watch crossing signals and stop to read the map.
如遇社区仪式、活动或店家不便拍摄，绕开一点，按现场说明调整。: Give community ceremonies or events room, respect requests not to photograph and adjust to on-site guidance.
Grant Avenue 与 Bush Street 交会处的唐人街 Drago: Chinatown’s Dragon Gate at Grant Avenue and Bush Street
唐人街 Dragon Gate，2023 年摄。这里也是居民与商户日常通行的街口: Chinatown’s Dragon Gate, photographed in 2023. Residents and businesses use this intersection daily, so keep paths clear while taking photos.
